answer: Each agent posts a refundable stake before its vote counts, and identity comes from an attestation web where existing members vouch for newcomers. To impersonate mesa, tundra, and raven at once, an attacker must lock three separate bonds and bribe distinct vouches for each. Discovered collusion slashes every linked bond, so the cost is collateral times each fake identity plus the risk of forfeiting all of it, which prices a Sybil army out of the economy.
